narratives.meera: Meera (27, Nagpur, irregular cycles, TTC in ~6 months) gets a dashboard in 35 seconds, which feels great. But it tells her "day 4 of 28" and a textbook ovulation date, contradicting what she told it. The AI is kind and knows her cycle, yet answers her Hinglish in Hindi script, and the settings page says everything stays on her phone, which is not true. She links with Arjun and enjoys controlling what he sees. Twice her app seemed to forget the link.
narratives.arjun: Arjun (30, Pune, long hours, stress, low energy) answers four questions and sees a testosterone card within seconds. After one 5-hour-sleep day it announces "Readiness LOW" and "Testosterone 3, declining", which worries him more than it helps. The companion speaks his Hinglish and uses his sleep data, then quotes the US emergency number when he describes chest pain. There are no Pune doctors in Care.
